prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ interpretLookup }`. `interpretLookup(command, candidates)` formats already-supplied lookup results without performing I/O. Supported commands are `/find query`, `/brief query`, and `/pick:N query`, where `N` is a positive decimal integer. Only the first 50 input candidates may be considered. A valid candidate is an object with a non-empty string `title` and an absolute `http:` or `https:` URL in `url`; invalid candidates within that window are ignored. `summary` is optional and is treated as empty unless it is a string. `/find` returns every valid candidate as blocks formatted `title\nurl\nsummary`, separated by blank lines. `/brief` returns `title — url` lines. `/pick:N` returns the Nth valid candidate using the full block format, or `No results.` if N exceeds the valid count. Return `Invalid command.` for malformed commands, missing queries, invalid N values, non-string commands, or a non-array `candidates` value. Return `No results.` when a valid command has no selectable results. Preserve candidate order and do not mutate the command, array, or candidate objects.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
